tools.name: orb_ping
tools.description: Health and auth check — verifies the API key works. Orb API: GET /ping.

tools.name: orb_list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the Orb account. Orb API: GET /customers.

tools.name: orb_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by Orb customer id. Orb API: GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: orb_get_customer_by_external_id
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by your external customer id. Orb API: GET /customers/external_customer_id/{external_customer_id}.

tools.name: orb_get_customer_costs
tools.description: Get costs incurred by a customer over a timeframe. Orb API: GET /customers/{customer_id}/costs.

tools.name: orb_get_customer_credits
tools.description: Get a customer's credit balances by currency. Orb API: GET /customers/{customer_id}/credits.

tools.name: orb_get_customer_credits_ledger
tools.description: Get the append-only credit ledger for a customer. Orb API: GET /customers/{customer_id}/credits/ledger.

tools.name: orb_list_plans
tools.description: List plans configured in the Orb account. Orb API: GET /plans.

tools.name: orb_get_plan
tools.description: Fetch a single plan by id. Orb API: GET /plans/{plan_id}.

tools.name: orb_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions, optionally filtered by customer or status. Orb API: GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: orb_get_subscription
tools.description: Fetch a single subscription by id. Orb API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}.

tools.name: orb_get_subscription_costs
tools.description: Get costs for a subscription over a timeframe. Orb API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/costs.

tools.name: orb_get_subscription_usage
tools.description: Get metered usage for a subscription over a timeframe. Orb API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/usage.

tools.name: orb_get_subscription_schedule
tools.description: Get the plan-change schedule for a subscription. Orb API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/schedule.

tools.name: orb_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by customer, subscription, or status. Orb API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: orb_get_invoice
tools.description: Fetch a single invoice by id. Orb API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: orb_get_upcoming_invoice
tools.description: Preview the upcoming (draft) invoice for a subscription. Orb API: GET /invoices/upcoming.

tools.name: orb_list_items
tools.description: List items (the things you bill for). Orb API: GET /items.

tools.name: orb_get_item
tools.description: Fetch a single item by id. Orb API: GET /items/{item_id}.

tools.name: orb_list_prices
tools.description: List prices configured in the Orb account. Orb API: GET /prices.

tools.name: orb_get_price
tools.description: Fetch a single price by id. Orb API: GET /prices/{price_id}.

tools.name: orb_list_metrics
tools.description: List billable metrics configured in the Orb account. Orb API: GET /metrics.

tools.name: orb_list_coupons
tools.description: List coupons in the Orb account. Orb API: GET /coupons.

tools.name: orb_list_alerts
tools.description: List usage/spend alerts, optionally filtered by customer or subscription. Orb API: GET /alerts.

tools.name: orb_create_customer
tools.description: Creates a new customer in Orb (additive). Requires name and a valid email. Orb API: POST /customers.

tools.name: orb_update_customer
tools.description: Updates an existing customer's details (reversible). Only provided fields are changed. Orb API: PUT /customers/{customer_id}.
